Reaching out to strangers only makes you money. You either:

1) Get nothing and end up in the same position as before.

2) You make money. 

So whether it’s 1 no or 1000 nos, you’re in the same spot. But 1 yes, can change everything.

No downside from no.
All upside from yes.
